mapper.sql: c.coupon_id,c.definition_id,c.definition_version version,c.member_id,d.store_id,d.name,CASE WHEN c.status='AVAILABLE' AND d.valid_to<=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) THEN 'EXPIRED' ELSE c.status END status,CAST(d.discount_amount AS CHAR) discount_amount,CAST(d.minimum_spend AS CHAR) minimum_spend,d.valid_from,d.valid_to,d.stackable,d.platform_funding_bps
